WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
), overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_account_avg
    FROM account_averages
)
SELECT aa.account_id,
       aa.avg_amount,
       aa.avg_amount - om.mean_account_avg AS above_mean
FROM account_averages AS aa
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om
WHERE aa.avg_amount > om.mean_account_avg
ORDER BY above_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The mean is computed across accounts that have at least one transaction, since only those accounts have a per-account average.
